subject: MdeModulePkg/Core: Validate DXE event signature before usage
reasons: Single-location security fix adding an event signature validation check to one function (CoreRegisterProtocolNotify)
The change adds a new condition to an existing NULL-pointer check; it requires semantic understanding of the IEVENT structure and EVENT_SIGNATURE constant
No repeated pattern across the codebase: this is a targeted use-after-free prevention in a single function
No neighboring commits share a similar signature-validation addition pattern
